country.evidence_quote: At the Medifast Metabolic Health Institute, we are dedicated to elevating the importance of metabolic health as a cornerstone of well-being. With metabolic dysfunction reaching critical levels in the United States*, the risks of inaction have never been higher. Our work is rooted in the belief that everyone deserves access to the science, education, tools, and support necessary to achieve and sustain optimal metabolic health.
